title: RES↔BIZ-001: Research Commercialization Potential + Market-Driven Research Priorities
description: The Researcher provides TRL (Technology Readiness Level) assessments for research outputs, transition-to-product timeline estimates for innovations, and IP (Intellectual Property) landscape assessments relevant to planned product features; the Business Consultant provides market-driven research priorities (which technology areas have the highest near-term commercial potential), business constraints on research timelines aligned with market windows, and competitive technology intelligence to direct research focus. Grounded in BUSINESS_CONSULTANT_SKILL §6.8. SOURCE NOTE: the edge is asymmetrically documented — IOT_EMBEDDED_SYSTEMS_RESEARCHER_SKILL §6 has no Business Consultant subsection (its §6.8 is Executive Leadership/CTO) — so fields derive from the Business Consultant side; reciprocity holds via the quarterly research-to-product alignment. A HIGH license-risk finding triggers legal review (per TTP_SCHEMA).

commercialization_potential.description: RES→BIZ: TRL, transition timeline, and IP-landscape assessment per research output.

legal_review_required.description: Must be true when license_risk = HIGH (TTP_SCHEMA: HIGH license risk → legal review).

market_research_priorities.description: BIZ→RES: prioritized technology areas, timeline constraints, competitive intelligence.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine commercialization-potential / research-priority alignment is agent-autonomous (quarterly research-to-product alignment; on-demand feasibility). A HIGH license-risk finding routes to legal review; commercialization that would seed a STRATEGIC product/technology bet is governed by the ADR/BIA process.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (quarterly research-to-product alignment sessions; on-demand for technology-feasibility assessments)
confirm_conditions: each research output carries a TRL (1–9) and a transition timeline with an explicit unit
the IP-landscape assessment states a license_risk and freedom_to_operate
a HIGH license-risk output flags legal_review_required = true
market priorities are BIZ-supplied (not researcher-invented commercial claims)
reject_conditions: a HIGH license-risk finding presented as product-ready without legal review (TTP_SCHEMA gate)
a TRL or transition timeline asserted without measured/characterized basis, or a timeline without a unit (units rule §3.10)
a commercialization recommendation that overstates readiness beyond the measured TRL (Honesty Over Polish §10.3)
counter_conditions: a market priority lacks a market-window date — request the window before sequencing research
an IP-landscape assessment is requested without the target product feature — request the feature scope before assessing freedom-to-operate
